content: विप्लव {%a.%} Perflexed, confused; मुमूर्षूणां हि मन्दात्मन्ननु स्युर्विप्लवा गिरः <ls>Bhāg. 7. 8. 12</ls>. .{@-वः@} .²1 Floating or drifting about, floating in different directions. .²2 Opposition, contrariety. .²3 Confusion, perplexity. .²4 Tumult, scuffle, affray; <ls>M. 1</ls>. .²5 Devastation, predatory warfare, danger from an enemy. .²6 Extortion. .²7 Loss, destruction; सत्त्वविप्लवात् <ls>R. 8. 41</ls>; तद्वाग्विसर्गो जनताघविप्लवः <ls>Bhāg. 1. 5. 11</ls>. .²8 Adverseness, evil turn; अथवा मम भाग्यविप्लवात् <ls>R. 8. 47</ls>. .²9 The rust on a mirror (dust accumulating on its surface); अपवर्जितविप्लवे शुचौ … मतिरादर्श इवाभिदृश्यते <ls>Ki. 2. 26</ls> (where विप्लव also means प्रमाणबाधः ‘absence of reasoning’). .²10 Transgression, violation; गुरूपदिष्टेन रिपौ सुतेऽपि वा निहन्ति दण्डेन स धर्मविप्लवम् <ls>Ki. 1. 13</ls>. .²11 An evil, a calamity. .²12 Sin, wickedness, sinfulness. .²13 Terrifying an enemy by shouts and gestures. .²14 Divulging, making public. .²15 Profanation of the Veda by unseasonable study. .²16 Shipwreck.
